AttributeList.Text: The input "0.000CC1-KE50_I1.6_SimitRunning" is a life bit from SIMIT, which is always TRUE while SIMIT is running. The following actions are performed in that case: - Simulation button in HMI is not shown when a SIMIT simulation is currently running - Deactivate PLC internal simulation while SIMIT simulation is running

The tag "Simulation".data.simulationActiveHmi is set/reset in HMI.
All software units look at the "Global.Data.general.activateSimulation" tag and set/reset themselves to simulation.
For safety, the "Safety.SafetySimulationDemoDB.simulationActive" tag is set/reset here, because there is no relation between the safety software unit and the global software unit.
